content: Check-in is from 15:00 to 21:00. Check-out is before 11:00. Late check-in after 21:00 must be arranged by phone in advance. Late check-out until 13:00 can be bought as an add-on.
content_zh: 入住時間為 15:00 至 21:00，退房時間為 11:00 前。21:00 後抵達須事先來電安排。可加購延遲退房至 13:00。

content: No. 18, Haifeng Road, Xincheng Township, Hualien County (fictional address). The inn is a five-minute walk from Qixingtan Beach.
content_zh: 花蓮縣新城鄉海風路 18 號（虛構地址），步行 5 分鐘可抵達七星潭。

content: The inn is a 15-minute drive from Hualien Railway Station and a 10-minute drive from Hualien Airport. A station pick-up service can be bought as an add-on and must be booked one day in advance.
content_zh: 距花蓮火車站車程 15 分鐘，距花蓮機場車程 10 分鐘。可加購火車站接駁服務，須於一日前預約。

content: The inn has 12 free parking spaces, first come, first served. When they are full, guests can use the public paid car park three minutes' walk away on Haifeng Road.
content_zh: 本民宿提供 12 個免費停車位，先到先停。車位已滿時，可停在步行 3 分鐘處的海風路公有收費停車場。

content: We accept cash, credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, JCB) and LINE Pay. A 30% deposit must be paid by bank transfer within three days after booking. The balance is paid at check-in.
content_zh: 接受現金、信用卡（Visa、Mastercard、JCB）及 LINE Pay。訂房後 3 日內須以銀行匯款支付 30% 訂金，餘款於入住時付清。

content: Cancel 14 or more days before check-in: full deposit refund. Cancel 7 to 13 days before: 50% of the deposit is refunded. Cancel less than 7 days before: no refund. If a typhoon warning is issued for Hualien, the stay can be moved to another date for free.
content_zh: 入住前 14 日以上取消，全額退還訂金；7 至 13 日取消，退還 50% 訂金；7 日內取消，訂金不予退還。花蓮地區發布颱風警報時，可免費改期。

content: Breakfast is served from 07:30 to 09:30 in the dining room on the first floor. It is not included in the room price and can be bought as an add-on.
content_zh: 早餐供應時間為 07:30 至 09:30，地點在一樓餐廳。房價不含早餐，可另外加購。

content: Pets are not allowed. Guide dogs are welcome.
content_zh: 本民宿不可攜帶寵物，導盲犬除外。

content: Smoking is not allowed indoors or on balconies. There is a smoking area in the garden.
content_zh: 室內及陽台全面禁菸，庭園設有吸菸區。

content: Free Wi-Fi is available in all rooms and public areas. The password is on the card in each room.
content_zh: 所有客房與公共區域均提供免費 Wi-Fi，密碼標示於房內卡片。

content: Quiet hours are from 22:00 to 07:00. Please keep noise low in rooms and the garden.
content_zh: 22:00 至 07:00 為安靜時段，請降低客房與庭園內的音量。

content: Children under 6 stay free if they share a bed with adults. They count toward the room's guest limit only when they need an extra bed.
content_zh: 6 歲以下兒童與大人同床不加床時免費；需要加床時，計入該房的人數上限。

content: Luggage can be stored for free at the front desk before check-in and after check-out on the same day.
content_zh: 入住前及退房當日，可免費於櫃檯寄放行李。

content: Qixingtan Beach: 5-minute walk. Taroko Gorge entrance: 30-minute drive. Dongdamen Night Market: 20-minute drive. Bicycles can be rented at the inn.
content_zh: 七星潭：步行 5 分鐘。太魯閣國家公園入口：車程 30 分鐘。東大門夜市：車程 20 分鐘。民宿提供自行車租借。
